title: Vampire bats keep a ledger
topic: Vampire bats regurgitate blood for starving roostmates, and they give most to the bats that fed them before
voice_script: A vampire bat will starve in two nights. Miss two meals and it dies, so the colony runs a blood debt. A bat that fed tonight will bring some back up for one that did not. It is not simple kindness. They give most to the bats that gave to them before, and kinship matters less than that record. Newcomers are tested with grooming first, then small donations. The colony is not a family. It is a ledger.
